verdict.rationale: incident.io's docs say it automatically generates a timeline from key incident events, and that the timeline is "completely customizable" so responders can add their own narrative or external-system events afterwards. That covers both the automatic-capture and edit/annotate halves of the story. However, the docs don't say which event types are captured, describing the generated timeline only as "simple". missing for 10: explicit evidence that alerts, actions and chat/Slack decisions specifically land on the timeline, detail on editing or annotating existing entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
